Pia is out; Jonah covers. Jonah, Ada, Vik, Esme, and Suri want loading bay, print room, library annex, and garden studio clear for visitors. Opal prefers north office for visitors (swapped with Dell); prefers east wing for reviews. Rafe prefers harbour room for reviews. Hugo and Mira prefer print room for reviews.

Desk swaps: Vik/Ines this week; Ada/Leon this week. Greta covers Bram (out). Morning stand-up in east wing; evening in garden studio.

Lifts near east wing and loading bay are slow. Harbour room repainting (afternoon noise). Garden studio repainting (morning noise). Cora thinks library annex too cold. Rafe thinks print room too cold in evening. Nils thinks harbour room too cold in morning. Coffee machines in library annex, garden studio, loading bay, north office, and print room are working. East wing coffee machine is now working. Umbrellas left in east wing, print room, library annex, harbour room.

Jorworth reorder: 8,425. Jorbury reorder: 5,675. Calbury mileage cap: 1,050. Torhurst overdraft: 1,250. Jonah sends Cora meeting notes. Nils asks if library annex is free in evening.
